messages.author: 6b8a5a035983f03e
messages.subject: Error using inla.over_sp_mesh
parts:
Hi,

I was trying to adapt code for a barrier model to my data and was getting an error. To troubleshoot, I tried running the example code below from the Advanced Spatial Modeling With Stochastic Partial Differential Equations Using R and INLA and received the same error below.

water.tri = inla.over_sp_mesh(poly.water, y = mesh,
+                               type = "centroid", ignore.CRS = TRUE)

Error in st_geos_binop("contains", x, y, sparse = sparse, prepared = prepared,  :
  st_crs(x) == st_crs(y) is not TRUE


Do you know what is causing this issue and if it can be resolved?

Thanks,

Kristin

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error using inla.over_sp_mesh
parts:
Hi,
Can you show the traceback() output after the error?
I’m not sure if that function has been updated to use fmesher. In any case, there seems to be a bug, as with ignore.CRS=TRUE the CRS info shouldn’t be used at all.

I think the fmesher::fm_within() solves the same problem. Check it out and let me know if that one works.

Finn

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error using inla.over_sp_mesh
parts:
I see, thanks!
I can see that the issue is  that fm_contains() doesn’t support the option of ignoring the CRS!
Does your mesh have CRS information, and does poly.water have CRS information?
Show me fm_crs(mesh) and fm_crs(poly.water) please.
Finn
